demoDisclaimer: Demo Speaking Rubric Feedback — simulated evaluation profiles based on IELTS Speaking descriptors. Microphone recording uses your browser MediaRecorder API locally.

criteria.name: Fluency and Coherence
criteria.feedback: Maintained natural speaking flow across the full 2-minute cue card with relevant discourse markers ('Initially', 'What stood out most'). Occasional filler pauses appear in abstract Part 3 follow-ups.

criteria.name: Lexical Resource
criteria.feedback: Effective descriptive phrasing and natural collocations. Push for stronger idiomatic precision when speculating about future urban trends.

criteria.name: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Reliable past and present continuous tenses. Incorporate more non-defining relative clauses and hypothetical conditionals ('were cities to invest...').

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.feedback: Clear vowel distinctions, expressive chunking, and natural sentence stress.

suggestions: Replace repetitive 'very good' with 'particularly impactful' or 'remarkably well-balanced'.
Extend Part 3 responses using the Point -> Reason -> Concrete Example -> Contrast frame.
